basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Project Associate (Computer Science and Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Indian Institute of Technology Indore has invited applications for a Project Associate in the research project "SecStand: Security and Standardization of 6G Systems", funded by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India. The pay is INR 50000.00 per month consolidated, including the applicable HRA. The essential qualification is a first class B.E./B.Tech with a GATE score in CSE, or a first class M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering or Electrical Engineering. Candidates send a detailed CV by e-mail

how_to_apply: Include in the CV the contact details (address, mobile phone no., email ID), date of birth, qualifications and grades, all mentioned clearly.
Give complete GATE score information in the CV: year of passing and validity, stream, score, marks, All India Rank and number of candidates appeared.
E-mail the CV to Prof. Neminath Hubballi, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Indore, at [email protected].
Write "Application for Project Associate Position" in the subject line.
Send the application on or before 25 Nov 2026.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications will not be considered. The subject line must necessarily mention "Application for Project Associate Position". The CV must carry the full GATE score details listed above.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Project Associate at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the age limit or the application fee.

Indian Institute of Technology Indore, Khandwa Road, Simrol, Indore

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by Indian Institute of Technology Indore, Khandwa Road, Simrol, Indore 453 552, and is dated 17 Nov 2026. The SecStand project aims to investigate broader security concerns of 6th generation telecom networks and design solutions to address them.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is a first class B.E./B.Tech with GATE Score in CSE, or First Class M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering or Electrical Engineering. Candidates from other branches who have experience may be considered if the experience is relevant to the project theme. Desirable: candidates with knowledge of Computer Networks, Wireless Communications and working knowledge of Linux systems, and who are willing to pursue a Ph.D at IIT Indore, will be given preference. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Emoluments are INR 50000.00 per month Consolidated, and this includes the applicable HRA. The initial appointment is for one year. It is extendable further, based on performance, up to the duration of the project. The selected candidate may be considered for admission to the Ph.D. program as a regular full-time candidate at IIT Indore, subject to meeting IIT Indore's admission/selection criteria. The position is liable to be terminated with one month's notice during the employment period.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Project Associate
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed CV. Include in the CV the contact details (address, mobile phone no., email ID), date of birth, qualifications and grades, all mentioned clearly. Give complete GATE score information in the CV: year of passing and validity, stream, score, marks, All India Rank and number of candidates appeared. E-mail the CV to Prof. Neminath Hubballi, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Indore, at [email protected] . Write "Application for Project Associate Position" in the subject line. Send the application on or before 25 Nov 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are called for an interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email for the interview. The notice does not give the interview date or venue. No TA/DA or accommodation will be provided for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will not be considered. The subject line must necessarily mention "Application for Project Associate Position". The CV must carry the full GATE score details listed above.
